text: Completed the EyeLink native-evidence layer. ASC GAZE/HREF/RAW events, messages, tracker metadata, source/block/raw provenance, and malformed records are preserved without entering DetectionResult. Messages convert exact decimal milliseconds into ObservedTimeline only; equal effective times retain source order. Start/end reconciliation is source-, block-, event-, eye-, and onset-sensitive and reports duplicate, orphan, mismatched, and unclosed pairs while retaining all records. Blink-to-sample reconciliation is an explicit policy over confirmed native intervals with half-open support; missing samples alone remain signal loss. Full eyes4s-io JVM and Scala.js suites plus formatting gates passed (Scala.js 100/100; JVM suite green). Mutation checks killed reversed message-offset arithmetic, swapped saccade endpoints, and an inclusive blink-end boundary on both platforms. git diff --check is clean.
